purpose: Prevent a later round from re-running defective production scripts and treating their output as valid.
THE_CENTRAL_WARNING: R12C REPAIRED NOTHING IN THE PRODUCTION PATH. Every repair was executed as a shadow measurement against sealed inputs. The production scripts named below are unchanged and still carry every defect listed. Running them today reproduces the same wrong results that R10, R11, R12 and R12B produced, and those results will look normal.
why_this_file_exists: R12C's artefacts report repaired numbers. The scripts that produced the original numbers were not modified. Without this register, a later reader could reasonably assume the pipeline now behaves as the R12C reports describe. It does not.

defects.defect: No pagination construct of any kind. No cursor, cursorMark, offset, resumptionToken or loop. Every API is queried exactly once and truncated at its page-size literal.
defects.effect_if_rerun: Candidate pool remains capped at one page per query regardless of how much the source holds.

defects.defect: Measured capture ratio of 0.0075 on its own largest query: 10591 addressable, 79 captured.
defects.effect_if_rerun: Reproduces a ~0.75% sample and presents it as a corpus.

defects.defect: relevant() inspects the title only and requires both a subject token and a topic token. Measured rejection of 79.0% of records that already passed the licence filter and the subject query.
defects.effect_if_rerun: Rejects roughly four in five qualified papers before they are ever fetched.

defects.defect: The script declares itself a bounded discovery enhancement, not a primary acquisition. Its manifest carries gate_dependency ENHANCEMENT_NOT_PREREQUISITE_GATE_ALREADY_GO.
defects.effect_if_rerun: Its output is not a population sample and must not be treated as one, which is the error R11, R12 and R12B inherited.

defects.measured: 1429 forms queued as NO_FROZEN_R6_RULE; 33 mapped. Fragment tokenisation recovers 515 under the identical existing rules.
defects.effect_if_rerun: Discards roughly a third of resolvable ontology forms again.

defects.defect: table_is_consumer() scans the WHOLE ARTICLE TEXT. One occurrence of consumer, customer, hedonic, liking or preference anywhere in a paper rejects every table in it, unless one of four exact phrases also appears.
defects.measured: 175 of 392 table rejections (44.6%). 36 candidates entirely killed, of which 35 have professional sensory titles and only 5 have consumer-study titles.
defects.effect_if_rerun: Discards professional sensory papers on an incidental word.

defects.defect: TABLE_SUPERVISION_CUE requires a caption keyword match and never inspects table content.
defects.effect_if_rerun: Rejects sensory tables whose captions use other vocabulary.

defects.measured: 17 candidates discarded. The repaired shadow recovered 18.

346 of 397 cached tables (87.2%) receive no descriptor-axis decision at all.
defects.note: Tokenisation recovers only 36 of them. The remainder is bounded by F14 and is not fully explained.
defects.effect_if_rerun: The largest single loss point in extraction remains.

defects.defect: The recognisable vocabulary is 126 terms: 56 concepts, 42 frozen R6 rules, 30 NATIVE_DIMENSIONS. descriptor_axis requires two recognisable terms on one axis.
defects.effect_if_rerun: Any upstream repair delivers more material into a stage whose ceiling has not moved.

defects.defect: resolve_surface() never consults NATIVE_DIMENSIONS while dimension_surface() does. Two functions in the same module disagree about what vocabulary exists.
defects.measured: 302 of roughly 1090 ranked fragment occurrences, including sweet, fruity, floral, sour and roasted, are recoverable with zero owner decisions.

before_any_future_acquisition_round: Do not re-run acquire_license_verified_r10.py as a primary acquisition. Add pagination and replace the title-only filter first.
Do not treat any count produced by the unrepaired pipeline as a measurement of the literature.
The 126-term vocabulary ceiling binds every upstream repair. Raising it requires owner-approved R6 rules; the R12C review sheet ranks the candidates and finds 7 of the top 60 need no decision at all.
The existing acquisition-state registries were restored in this round and are available; the R10 script does not use them.

operator_introduced_defects.what_it_was: The A1 runtime-boundary test forced a fresh import by deleting sklearn, scipy, numpy and lxml from sys.modules. numpy cannot be re-imported after eviction, so every later test in the same process that touched the scientific stack failed inside numpy's own partially-initialised package.
operator_introduced_defects.blast_radius: 6 errors across test_sensory_views_r1, test_sequential_context, test_training_r4 and test_verify_conditioning_r4. All 18 of those tests pass when run without the A1 test in the same process, which is how the damage stayed invisible to a per-module run.
operator_introduced_defects.why_the_eviction_was_never_needed: The import statement calls __import__ on every execution, cached or not. A guard installed on builtins.__import__ observes the import whether or not the module is already in sys.modules. Eviction bought nothing and cost the suite.
operator_introduced_defects.repair: Evict only project-local modules (pure Python, no extension state), so a runtime module's own top-level imports re-execute under the guard; leave every third-party module cached. Restore the evicted local modules in a finally block so a failed import leaves nothing partial behind.

positive_control_added.reason: Removing the eviction changes how detection works, so the two boundary tests could have gone green by ceasing to detect anything. The control imports audit_semantic_integrity_r9, which genuinely imports flavor_m2_r1, and requires the guard to report it. If the guard stops firing, this test fails and says the other two cannot be trusted.

verification.isolation_check: test_runtime_boundary_round2 followed by the four affected modules in one process: 22 tests, OK

process_finding.cause: The commit was made after running only the two new test modules, not the full suite. A test that damages interpreter state is invisible to a per-module run by construction.
process_finding.standing_rule_adopted: A test module that mutates interpreter-global state (sys.modules, builtins, sys.path, environment, working directory) must restore it in a finally block, and must be verified by running the full suite in one process, never module by module.
process_finding.relation_to_owner_instruction: Owner's standing rule is that scripts producing the same broken results after a push are landmines. This was that failure mode inside the test layer rather than the pipeline layer.

infrastructure_defects.what: The research working tree /private/tmp/coffee-flavor-round3m is a git worktree living under /private/tmp. macOS periodically removes files there. On 2026-09-10 00:00 it removed 1,262 tracked files (both 50K ledgers, the question-axis TSV, the rights matrix, README, LICENSE, the app tree) and the one-line .git pointer file, leaving the tree unusable and git unaware it was a repository.
infrastructure_defects.what_was_NOT_lost: All commits on research/round2-capture (5c923e4..e5b225d) — worktree commits live in the main repository's .git at /Users/jarlgiovanni/Desktop/Coffee_Flavor_Research, which is not under /tmp. Every deleted file was in the committed tree and was restored with git checkout. Uncommitted round-2/round-3 work survived because it had been written within the cleanup window.
infrastructure_defects.detected_how: evidence_reader_round2.load_partitions() returned 0 partitions during a CoffeeReview dataset assessment, producing an impossible figure (51 of 36 unreachable descriptors covered). Chasing that arithmetic found the missing file, then the missing .git.
infrastructure_defects.repair: Rewrote .git as 'gitdir: <main>/.git/worktrees/coffee-flavor-round3m'; restored only --deleted paths so the 2 modified and 7 untracked working files were untouched; full suite 398 OK afterwards.
infrastructure_defects.root_cause_still_open: The worktree is still under /private/tmp, as are 17 other Codex worktrees listed by git worktree list. The same cleanup will recur. Recommendation: git worktree move to a durable path outside /tmp; the owner decides where.
infrastructure_defects.standing_rule: Never place a working tree, cache, or artefact the project depends on under /tmp or /private/tmp. The scratchpad under /private/tmp/claude-501 is subject to the same policy and must hold nothing that is not also committed.

full_restricted_loss_inventory_2026_09_1.verdict: Every owner-private source-native root for the 20K/30K/40K/50K corpus is gone from this machine. Public TSVs (hashes + restricted pointers) are committed and intact.
full_restricted_loss_inventory_2026_09_1.why_tmp_was_chosen: Deliberate. generate-round2b-pilot.require_private_review_path and generate-round3i-language-artifacts.require_private_path both ASSERT the path is under /private/tmp AND not inside the repository. full_restricted_loss_inventory_2026_09_1.owner_question: Does the owner (or the Codex sessions that built rounds 3l-3m) hold the original captures elsewhere? CI's --require-restricted-real mode 'fails closed without owner inputs', which implies the owner supplies them at replay time from a location outside this machine's /tmp. If so, the loss is local and recoverable.
